value.rationale: Min-key search spine length is a natural BST boundary search-cost statistic and childless-vertex count is a fundamental global fringe statistic. The exact positive, increasing covariance that tends to 1/12, despite a vanishing standardized correlation, is a motivated structural dependence invariant; endpoint corrections at zero- and singleton-sized splits explain the result. No extension to a broader model or downstream theorem is claimed.
